name: Psilocybe cubensis

size_cm.note: cap 1.6 to 8 cm, from the Wikipedia article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psilocybe_cubensis), which cites Singer & Smith 1958, Mycologia 50; the original was not opened

notes: Diffuse with some strands. Very widely grown, so hobby-level growth data are abundant but rarely peer-reviewed; reported (unchecked) to have a sequenced genome. A controlled species in many places (survey section 6 asks whether to keep it).

tip_speed.note: genotype B+ filled 85 mm plates from an 8 mm plug (38.5 mm of radius) on PDA and malt agar by day 20, with areas measured every 5 days (Pepe, Hesami, Fleishmann, Hsiang & Jones 2025, Mycelium growth and development of Psilocybe spp. mother cultures on agar-based media, Journal of Fungi 11(6):450, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12194638/); 15 to 20 days gives 1.9 to 2.6 mm/day, about 80 to 107 um/h, and 90 is taken. Room temperature (no figure given), not the 30 C optimum, so the rate at the optimum is probably higher. Other genotypes were slower

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

t_opt.source: Ulloa & Herrera 1967, Factores que influyen en el crecimiento de los micelios de Psilocybe mexicana (Heim) y Psilocybe cubensis (Earle) Sing., Anales del Instituto de Biologia UNAM, Serie Botanica 38(1):165-192
t_opt.note: strain 56 from Huautla de Jimenez, Oaxaca; still liquid Kaufmann medium, dry weight after 15 days at 15, 18, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 C; most mycelium at 30 C

t_min.note: no mycelium formed from the inoculum at 15 or 18 C in 15 days, and it grew once moved to 25 C (Ulloa & Herrera 1967, https://anales.ib.unam.mx/index.php/SerBot/article/download/1354/1506); the highest no-growth temperature is taken as the limit. Read from a scanned text layer with garbled digits, and a 15-day liquid test may miss very slow growth

t_max.note: no mycelium formed at 40 C; it grew at 35 C (Ulloa & Herrera 1967, https://anales.ib.unam.mx/index.php/SerBot/article/download/1354/1506). Read from a scanned text layer with garbled digits
